**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 280 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- This ash staff is decorated with animals, elementals, and dragons. Creatures summoned using this staff gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the level of the spell used to summon them. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Staff of Summoning **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 280 **Price** 230 gp ---
  • **Cantrip** [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713)
  • **1st** [_summon animal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1694)
  • **2nd** [_marvelous mount_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1594), [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606), summon animal, [_summon elemental_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1698)
Staff of Summoning (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 280 **Price** 900 gp ---
  • **3rd** summon animal, summon elemental
  • **4th** marvelous mount, summon animal, summon elemental
Staff of Summoning (Major) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 280 **Price** 4,000 gp ---
  • **5th** summon animal, [_summon dragon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1697), summon elemental
  • **6th** marvelous mount, summon animal, summon dragon, summon elemental
name: Staff of Summoning (Major)
